title: Your personal Executive Assistant
summary: Never walk into a meeting unprepared again
body_markdown:
Your calendar knows when you have meetings.


Now it knows *why they matter.*


In our latest[demo](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7326385093269213184) , we introduce the **Calendar AI Agent** , built on Wordware to prep you automatically - before every call.


No more scrambling. This[autonomous agent](https://blog.wordware.ai/best-ai-agent-frameworks-for-developing-autonomous-systems) :


-


Researches meeting participants


-


Gathers relevant company context


-


Adds tailored notes directly to your calendar


It’s like having a personal chief of staff who keeps you informed and one step ahead - without you lifting a finger.


Built inside Wordware, the platform for[orchestrating AI agents](https://blog.wordware.ai/llm-orchestration-guide) across your business.[No code required](https://blog.wordware.ai/how-to-build-an-ai-agent-a-no-code-approach) - just describe what you want.
